description: Exhibition guide to El Encanto de un Pueblo / The Magic of a People / O Encanto dum Povo, HemisFair, World's Fair in San Antonio, Texas, April 6 through October 6, 1968. This exhibition contained "original Latin American Folk Art and Toys from the Girard Foundation collected by Alexander Girard, Santa Fe, New Mexico." Georgia O'Keeffe contributed rocks to the display.
title: El Encanto de un Pueblo, HemisFair
